locations.note: The opening mission is the assassination of Sheikh Ali Shaheed, with an arc that takes in the Jizan weapon stockpile and the arms dealer Nasri.
Marburg's Veteran Combat Initiative plots a false-flag bombing of a museum, and Marburg kidnaps Madison Saint James.
Omen Deng plots to assassinate President Sung.
The Russian mafia underboss Brayko and Surkov are hunted from Lazo's yacht to the US Embassy and Brayko's mansion.
